title: AbeBooks listing record (listings/<SKU>.json)
description: One book. tools/abe_publish.py turns this into a single <Abebook> element of an inventoryUpdateRequest. Full-record rule: every add/update must carry the complete record, because AbeBooks clears any field that is omitted.

sku.description: vendorBookID. NGP- + first 4 letters of the author surname + up to 4 title initials (all words if they fit, else major words only). Antiquarian and collectible books: NGA- + the same 4+4 + first 4 letters of the printer/publisher's name as catalogued + 4-digit year (an estimate is fine). Unique forever; never reuse.

photos.description: Repo-relative paths (photos/<SKU>/1.jpg) or full URLs; the workflow turns paths into raw.githubusercontent.com URLs.

pricing.description: How the price was derived. Not sent to AbeBooks. Regular books: the avg-total block. Antiquarian: the 'comparable' block from tools/abe_local.py price --method comparable — anchor, competitive band, realized floor, flags, the comps with kind/match/quality, and a 'rationale' in words (required).

condition_points.description: Specific condition points observed in the photos. Not sent as a field; they are written into the description.

not_seen_in_photos.description: Parts of the book the photos did not show. Not sent.

format.description: Antiquarian: bibliographical format — folio, 4to, 8vo, 12mo, ... (also goes into size with the leaf height).

collation.description: Antiquarian: signature formula and pagination, e.g. 'A-Z4 Aa-Ff4; [8], 226, [6] pp.' — or 'not collated'.

collation_verified.description: Antiquarian: true only if the collation was checked leaf by leaf against a reference (ESTC, USTC, VD16...) or a digitised copy. False means the description must say 'not collated'.

completeness.description: Antiquarian: 'complete', 'apparently complete, not collated', or exactly what is lacking or supplied.

binding_description.description: Antiquarian: period, material, decoration, edges, endpapers, repairs — the full sentence that also appears in the description.

provenance.description: Antiquarian: inscriptions, bookplates, stamps, sale records — with dates where legible.

references.description: Antiquarian: bibliographical references found — 'ESTC S123456', 'USTC 123456', 'VD16 P 1234', 'Adams P1234', 'Brunet IV, 716', 'Wing L1234'. Empty list if none traced; say so in the description.

history_note.description: Antiquarian: 2-5 sentences on the work, the edition and why it matters — evidenced, no puffery.
